name: unreleased-lock-context
text:
The children that were started within the span a compaction summarizes and have not ended can be listed.

`crates/context/src/lib.rs` builds the state that travels across a compaction cut as data. `children` writes one entry per `spawn/end` event within the covered span, with the contract that child's `spawn/start` named, after the entries carried from earlier compactions. A child whose `spawn/start` lies in the span and whose `spawn/end` has not arrived appears in no entry, so once the transcript below the cut is gone nothing states that the child is still running.

Add `pub fn unfinished_children(events: &[Event], covered: Covered) -> Vec<String>` to that module, returning the identifier of every child whose `spawn/start` lies within `covered` and for which the events hold no `spawn/end`, in byte order and without duplicates. Add a unit test for a child that started and ended within the span, for one that started within it and has not ended, and for a span that holds no spawn.

The documents under docs/ describe the behavior. Each sentence below belongs in the document named before it, in the same words:
- docs/compaction.md: a child started within the summarized span whose end has not arrived is reported apart from the children that ended, so a compaction hides no running child.

checks/run.sh runs the checks this task is judged on: scripts/loc.sh, the release of checks/context.lock, the tests of foe-context, and clippy with warnings denied on the same crates.

Follow AGENTS.md. Run the checks it names. When you finish, or when you cannot, report your outcome.
